name: ykb-pr-reviewer-extended
description: Bitbucket Pull Request'lerini Superpowers skill rubric ile Copilot uzerinden inceler; sonucu workspace root'ta review-*.md olarak yazar

viewsWelcome.contents:
Reviewer olarak atandigin PR'lar burada listelenir.
[Token kaydet](command:ykbPrReviewerExtended.saveToken)
[Yenile](command:ykbPrReviewerExtended.refreshInboxPrs)

Bir repo sec veya search yap; acik PR'lar listelenir.
[Repo ara](command:ykbPrReviewerExtended.searchRepoPrs)
[Repo sec](command:ykbPrReviewerExtended.pickRepo)

ykbPrReviewerExtended.token.markdownDescription: Bitbucket Personal Access Token. Bos birakilirsa ilk calistirmada sorulur ve guvenli depoya kaydedilir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.model.markdownDescription: Kullanilacak Copilot model ID'si veya family adi (`aiIdeAssistant.use` false iken). Sidebar **Ayarlar** view'undaki Copilot model select ile settings.json'a yazilir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.extraInstructions.markdownDescription: Her review'a eklenen proje ozel talimatlar. Sidebar **Ayarlar** view'undaki **Ek talimatlar** textarea ile settings.json'a yazilir (blur). Satir basina bir kural yazin. `prompt.includeExtraInstructions` false ise gonderilmez.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.javaHome.markdownDescription: Java home yolu. Bos ise `java.jdt.ls.java.home`, `java.home` veya `JAVA_HOME` settings/env'den okunur.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.npmPath.markdownDescription: npm executable yolu. Bos ise VS Code npm/node ayarlari veya PATH'ten cozumlenir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.maxDiffChars.description: Her dosyanin diff metni icin maksimum karakter (chunk icinde). 0 = sinirsiz.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.maxPromptChars.description: System + user chrome + dosya paketi toplam karakter tavani (0 = sinirsiz). Qwen3.6 262k context ile hizali default; packer dosya atlamaz, hybrid chunk kullanir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.maxFileChars.description: Degisen dosyanin tam icerigi icin maksimum karakter; asilirsa truncated isaretlenir. 0 = sinirsiz.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.contextExpansion.e.description: PR review oncesi repo cache clone + codegraph ile related context ekle.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.contextExpansion.c.description: Repo cache kok dizini. Bos ise %USERPROFILE%/repo_review kullanilir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.contextExpansion.m.description: Related context olarak eklenecek maksimum dosya sayisi.
Related context dosya icerigi karakter tavanı. 0 = sinirsiz.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.contextExpansion.o.description: Repo icinde consumer bulunamayan symbol'ler icin review davranisi.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.contextExpansion.d.description: Related context ve codegraph index disinda birakilacak path segment'leri (unit test dizinleri dahil).

ykbPrReviewerExtended.contextExpansion.r.description: Inquiry PR'larda related context olarak eklenmeyecek batch/parser path segment'leri (changed dosyalar yine review edilir).

ykbPrReviewerExtended.findingGate.enable.description: LLM review sonrasi FP/oversevere Critical drop/downgrade gate.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.codeReview.minConf.description: Code Review: bu confidence altindaki bulgu elenir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.codeReview.critica.description: Code Review: bu confidence ve uzeri Critical. minConfidence ile bu deger arasi Important.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.ocrReview.executab.markdownDescription: Alibaba Open Code Review CLI yolu (`ocr` / `ocr.cmd`). Bos ise PATH'ten cozumlenir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.crgReview.executab.markdownDescription: tirth8205/code-review-graph CLI yolu (`code-review-graph` / `.cmd`). Bos ise PATH'ten cozumlenir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.crgReview.maxConte.description: detect-changes stdout'unun LLM prompt'a eklenen max karakter sayisi.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prAgentReview.exec.markdownDescription: The-PR-Agent/pr-agent CLI yolu (`pr-agent` / `pr-agent.cmd`). Bos ise PATH'ten cozumlenir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.openPreview.description: Review md dosyasi yazildiktan sonra Markdown Preview ac.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.autoReview.enabled.description: Otomatik PR review zamanlayicisini VS Code acilisinda baslat.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.aiIdeAssistant.use.markdownDescription: true ise review, mevcut `ai-ide-assistant.providers` listesindeki `enabled: true` kaydi kullanir. false ise Copilot (`ykbPrReviewerExtended.model`).

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.systemRole.description: IDE assistant ilk mesaj role (varsayilan: system).

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.userRole.description: IDE assistant ikinci mesaj role (varsayilan: user).

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeSkil.description: System prompt'a Superpowers skill metinlerini ekle.
Multi-chunk findings-only prompt'a skill metinlerini ekle (default kapali; token verimi).

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.compactFind.description: Multi-chunk findings-only i>0 chunk'larda kisa kural seti (severity map + denylist); false ise v1 full domain her chunk'ta.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeScop.description: System prompt'a Diff/File scope kuralini ekle.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeCont.description: System prompt'a context expansion (Changed/Related, suppress speculative) kuralini ekle.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeYkbD.description: System prompt'a YKB domain kurallarini ekle.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeEnvi.description: System prompt'a javaHome/npmPath ortam blogunu ekle.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeOutp.description: System prompt'a cikti formati / findings-only hint ekle.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeChun.description: User mesajinin SONUNA chunk hatirlatmasini ekle (Diff'ten sonra).

ykbPrReviewerExtended.prompt.includeFile.description: User mesajina #### File (tam dosya icerigi) ekle. false ise yalnizca Diff gider.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.ui.fontSizePx.description: Sidebar PR listesi font-size (px). settings.example.json icinden degistirilir.

ykbPrReviewerExtended.ui.iconSizePx.description: Sidebar buton ici SVG ikon boyutu (px).
